name: barkskin
lore:
# Barkskin: The Aegis of the Verdant Heart

To invoke *Barkskin* is to invite the slow, unyielding patience of the forest into one’s marrow. As the caster shapes the Weave, it feels not like a spark, but like a deep, grounding hum—the scent of damp loam and ancient resin filling the senses.

The manifestation is a marvel of transmutation. The subject’s skin thickens, hardening into overlapping plates of ironwood and cork. Deep, protective ridges form, occasionally weeping golden amber where the magic is densest. It is a living bulwark that mocks the bite of steel and the sting of arrows.

Legend attributes its discovery to Elara of the Deepwood. When a rampaging titan threatened the Heart-Tree, Elara stood her ground, shielding the sapling with her body. The forest, sensing her sacrifice, surged through her veins, petrifying her flesh into gnarled oak. She endured the titan’s fury, and from her survival, this rite was transcribed. 

For the wanderer, this spell is more than armor; it is the forest’s own resilience, lent to those who walk the wild ways.
